requirements.title: Education
requirements.description: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
requirements.explanation: The candidate holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.

requirements.title: Programming Languages
requirements.description: Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript.
requirements.explanation: The candidate is proficient in Python and JavaScript.

requirements.title: Technical Skills
requirements.description: Experience with software development methodologies, data structures, algorithms, database technologies, version control systems, and possibly cloud platforms.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience with Agile methodology, data structures, algorithms, SQL, and Git.

requirements.title: Full-Stack Web Development
requirements.description: Knowledge of full-stack web development, including HTML, CSS, and frameworks like React or Angular.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience with React for frontend development.

requirements.title: Soft Skills
requirements.description: Problem-solving skills, communication, teamwork, attention to detail, and a proactive attitude.
requirements.explanation: The candidate demonstrates excellent problem-solving skills, communication, and attention to detail.

wishes.title: Cloud Platforms
wishes.description: Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
wishes.explanation: The candidate's experience with cloud platforms is not mentioned.
